newsitem.title: ITALY: Olivetti to issue statement on Sept 18.
newsitem.headline: Olivetti to issue statement on Sept 18.

text.p: Italy's struggling information technology group Olivetti said it will release a statement on September 18 in response to the 16 questions on its financial accounts put by stock market authority Consob.

Olivetti had been due to reply to the questions on Tuesday, but has now decided to delay its statement. An Olivetti spokeswoman said the company's communique would be released around 0600 GMT on September 18.
Earlier, Consob said if Olivetti had released its statement late on Tuesday evening, it would not have time to examine the group's response fully.
